question: According to the WHO Constitution (1948), health is defined as 'a state of complete physical, mental and social well-being and not merely the absence of disease or infirmity.'

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect. The WHO 1948 Constitution Preamble defines health as 'a state of complete physical, mental and social well-being and not merely the absence of disease or infirmity.' The word 'spiritual' was added in later discussions but is NOT part of the original 1948 text.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The WHO 1948 definition explicitly includes physical, mental and social well-being — and the phrase 'not merely the absence of disease or infirmity' is part of the canonical text.
